agent_protocol.subagent_brief: Plan 5 replaces the Plan 4 reviewer stub with a real 6-axis parallel-fanout reviewer, adds a draft-PR creator (push branch + open draft PR via ADO REST), and adds a worktree-teardown final stage. Reads the plan markdown for design context; the controller provides full verbatim code per task. Strict TDD: failing test first, verify failure, minimal implementation, verify pass, commit.
agent_protocol.tdd_pattern: Tasks that include test files follow strict TDD: (1) write the failing test, (2) run the test to verify it fails with the expected message, (3) write the minimal implementation, (4) run the test to verify it passes, (5) commit.
agent_protocol.completion_criteria: A task is complete only when every entry in 'verification_commands' exits 0 with the expected output AND the commit described in 'commit' has been created.
do_not: Do not skip the 'verify it fails' step.
Do not amend or rewrite earlier commits.
Do not run --no-verify or skip hooks.
Do not introduce real network calls or real Claude SDK calls in tests. Mock the runner, mock the AdoClient, mock the worktree-manager.
Do not add the `code-review` label when creating draft PRs — that's a human action by design.
Do not write a Skill-based parallel-dispatch mechanism for the reviewer — Plan 5 uses TypeScript `Promise.all` of 6 `runner.run()` calls.
Do not tear down the worktree on failure paths (analyzer reject, coder/test-author error, reviewer exhaustion, PR-creation failure) — humans inspect what the agent left behind.

Port the rule content from C:/GeneralDev/DevOpsPullers/DevOpsCodeReviewer/.claude/skills/code-review/agents/*.md, adapt to JSON output schema (Finding[]). Content task, no tests.

tasks.name: Reviewer stage (full rewrite)
tasks.summary: Replace src/pipeline/stages/reviewer.ts body. createReviewerStage(deps) returns Stage that runs 6 axes in parallel via Promise.all of runner.run<ReviewerAxisOutput>(...). Each axis call: cwd=worktree.path, tools=[Read,Grep,Glob,Bash,Skill], disallowedTools=[Edit,Write,NotebookEdit], Bash allowlist (read-only), maxTurns=30. Aggregate findings via aggregateReviewerFindings. Compute approved=(no blocking AND no critical). Store state.outputs.reviewer={approved,findings,attempts:state.outputs.reviewer?.attempts+1||1}. ~10 tests.

tasks.name: Coder reads prior reviewer feedback
tasks.summary: Extend buildCoderUserPrompt to accept optional previousReviewerFeedback: Finding[]. Render a 'Previous reviewer findings — address or justify ignoring' section when feedback is present. The coder stage's execute reads state.outputs.reviewer?.findings (if any) and passes them. Update 1 existing test (no-feedback case) and add 2 new tests (with-feedback rendering, multiple findings).

tasks.name: PR description template
tasks.summary: Create src/prompts/draft-pr-description.md. Template uses {{placeholder}} syntax filled by code (NOT model-rendered). Sections: WI link, analyzer summary, coder summary, test-author summary, reviewer note (approved or 'approved with N non-blocking findings').

tasks.name: Draft-PR creator stage
tasks.summary: Create src/pipeline/stages/draft-pr-creator.ts. Pushes branch via Bun.spawn('git', ['push', 'origin', branch]) cwd=worktree.path. Calls ado.createPullRequest with title=`[Agent] ${wiCtx.title}`, body from template, isDraft=true, sourceRefName=`refs/heads/${branch}`, targetRefName=`refs/heads/main`. Stores state.outputs.draftPr={id,url,branch,createdAt}. Throws on push failure or PR-creation failure (terminal). Test override: pushBranch function in deps.

tasks.name: Worktree-teardown stage
tasks.summary: Create src/pipeline/stages/worktree-teardown.ts. Calls worktreeManager.removeWorktree({workItemId, slug, persistedWorktree: state.outputs.worktree}). Best-effort: try/catch around removeWorktree, log error, return state unchanged on failure. No throw. Stage canRun always true; skips silently if state.outputs.worktree is undefined.

tasks.name: Pipeline-builder assembles full chain + onExhausted
tasks.summary: Update src/services/pipeline-builder.ts. New stage list: [analyzer, worktreeSetup, revisionLoop(coder, reviewer, onExhausted), testAuthor, draftPrCreator, worktreeTeardown]. onExhausted handler: throws an Error so the orchestrator's terminal-failure branch fires. Add new injection points: reviewerPromptTemplates (Record<axis, string>), reviewerSharedTemplate, prDescriptionTemplate, pushBranch override. Update existing tests for new chain shape (length 6, new stage names). ~3 new tests.

tasks.name: Processor: post reviewer findings on exhaustion
tasks.summary: Update src/services/processor.ts terminal-error path. When state.outputs.reviewer.findings.length > 0, render a markdown comment ('Reviewer rejected after N attempts. Findings:') via marked, post via ado.addWorkItemComment. THEN add blockedTag (existing behavior). Wrap in safeAdoOp. Dry-run still suppresses ADO writes. ~3 new tests.

tasks.name: CLI: debug-pr <id> command
tasks.summary: Add 'debug-pr' subcommand to src/cli/index.ts. Loads state, prints state.outputs.draftPr as JSON (or 'no draft PR recorded' if missing). Manual smoke only.

tasks.name: Integration e2e: PR pipeline
tasks.summary: Create tests/integration/pr-e2e.test.ts. Real watcher+processor+buildPipeline+revisionLoop+state-store; mock AdoClient, AgentRunner, WorktreeManager. 4 scenarios: (1) happy path with first-attempt approval → PR created → teardown; (2) revisionLoop iterates (reviewer rejects attempt 1, approves attempt 2) → PR created with single set of commits stacked; (3) revisionLoop exhausts (3 rejects) → blockedTag + findings comment + no PR + worktree intact; (4) PR creation fails → terminal failure + blockedTag + no teardown.
